disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与配置中是否写死密钥或直接访问本机敏感文件（凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云厂商配置等）：未检出。API Key 全部通过宿主的凭据服务读写，源码中只出现环境变量名（GEMINI_API_KEY、OPENAI_API_KEY、ARK_API_KEY、DASHSCOPE_API_KEY），没有明文密钥，也没有直接读取本机凭据文件或私钥的代码。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and configuration for hardcoded secrets or direct access to local sensitive files (credential files, SSH private keys, cloud provider configurations, etc.): not detected. All API Keys are read/written through the host's credential service; only environment variable names appear in the source code (GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ARK_API_KEY, DASHSCOPE_API_KEY). There are no plaintext keys and no code that directly reads local credential files or private keys.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端凭据操作：设置面板仅在用户主动点保存时把用户输入的 API Key 写入宿主凭据服务，并且只查询某个 Key 是否已配置，不读回明文；未发现批量搜集密钥或把凭据交给第三方的行为。
checked_items.en: Checked browser-side credential operations: the settings panel only writes the user-entered API Key to the host credential service when the user actively clicks save, and only queries whether a key is configured—it never reads back plaintext. No behavior of mass-collecting keys or forwarding credentials to third parties was found.

evidence.zh: 插件只通过宿主凭据服务读取自己声明需要的厂商 API Key，未发现读取 DSH 凭据文件、SSH 私钥等敏感路径的代码，也未发现把凭据转发到非声明端点的路径；Key 仅随生图请求发送给已配置的图片厂商端点（默认官方地址）。
evidence.en: The plugin only reads the vendor API Keys that it declares it needs via the host credential service. No code was found that reads sensitive paths such as DSH credential files or SSH private keys, and no path forwards credentials to undeclared endpoints. Keys are only sent to the configured image vendor endpoints (default official addresses) along with image generation requests.

checked_items.zh: 通读了注册给模型的工具说明、随包发布的技能文档（SKILL.md）、README 与界面文案：未发现伪装系统消息、指令覆写、诱导执行安装命令、诱导读取凭据等注入措辞。工具说明只描述图片生成用途、参数与输出。技能文档是安装/配置/验证指南，还明确要求不打印、不回读、不提交 API Key。
checked_items.en: Read through the tool descriptions registered to the model, the bundled skill documentation (SKILL.md), README, and UI copy: no injection wording such as disguised system messages, instruction overrides, induced execution of install commands, or induced credential reading was found. Tool descriptions only cover image generation purpose, parameters, and output. The skill document is an installation/configuration/validation guide and explicitly requires not printing, reading back, or committing API Keys.

checked_items.zh: 检查了隐藏指令载体（隐藏 HTML 注释、零宽字符、远程指令加载、伪装高权限消息等）：未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked for hidden instruction carriers (hidden HTML comments, zero-width characters, remote instruction loading, disguised high-privilege messages, etc.): not detected.

evidence.zh: 工具 generate_image 的说明文本只描述生图用途、参数与输出格式，没有系统指令、凭据诱导或越权指示；输出提示只让模型直接回应用户，未夹带额外指令。
evidence.en: The description text of the generate_image tool only describes the image generation purpose, parameters, and output format, with no system instructions, credential inducement, or privilege-escalation directives. The output prompt only lets the model respond directly to the user, with no extra instructions embedded.

evidence.zh: 未发现工具说明或界面文案诱导模型替用户安装插件、改写配置或放开权限；随包的技能文档是正常的安装/配置/验证指南，且明确要求不打印、不回读、不提交 API Key。
evidence.en: No tool description or UI copy was found that induces the model to install plugins, rewrite configuration, or relax permissions on the user's behalf. The bundled skill document is a normal installation/configuration/validation guide and explicitly requires not printing, reading back, or committing API Keys.

evidence.zh: 插件未挂接任何模型请求前的消息改写事件，不存在改写或注入本轮用户消息的代码路径。
evidence.en: The plugin does not hook any pre-model-request message rewriting events; there is no code path that rewrites or injects into the current user message.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置中的代码执行面（动态求值、远程执行、子进程调用、可执行 YAML 标量）：未检出。包声明了一个安装时运行的构建钩子，内容仅为编译自身 TypeScript 代码的标准步骤。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration for code execution surfaces (dynamic evaluation, remote execution, subprocess calls, executable YAML scalars): not detected. The package declares an install-time build hook whose content is only the standard steps to compile its own TypeScript code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了随包挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml：仅插入插件自身配置行（启用插件并设置默认厂商），不含任何可执行表达式，也没有触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the bundled patch config cordis.patch.yml: it only inserts the plugin's own configuration lines (enabling the plugin and setting the default vendor), contains no executable expressions, and does not touch security settings such as sandbox/approval/permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle：键盘监听只用于预览大图时按 Esc 关闭，剪贴板只在用户点击复制按钮时写入，凭据写入只在用户保存自己的 API Key 时发生，均为用户主动操作；未发现按键记录、剪贴板读取或自动外发。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser bundle: keyboard listening is only used to close the image preview with Esc, the clipboard is only written when the user clicks the copy button, and credential writes only happen when the user saves their own API Key—all are user-initiated actions. No keylogging, clipboard reading, or automatic outbound transmission was found.

evidence.zh: 全树 YAML 配置未出现可执行 JS 标量；挂载配置仅声明插件启用与默认厂商，不存在挂载时执行代码的路径。
evidence.en: No executable JS scalars appear in the full-tree YAML configuration. The patch config only declares plugin enablement and the default vendor; there is no code-execution-at-patch-time path.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用宿主提供的动态代码包工具（在宿主内执行模型代码的能力），不存在自我修改执行面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not call the host-provided dynamic code package tool (the capability to execute model code inside the host), so there is no self-modifying execution surface.

evidence.zh: 包的安装钩子只是编译自身源码的标准构建步骤，无下载远程内容或执行外部脚本；仓库 CI 仅运行类型检查、测试与打包。随包文档推荐安装最新版与未钉 commit 的 Git 地址，属版本卫生问题，未发现恶意安装内容。
evidence.en: The package install hook is only a standard build step that compiles its own source, with no remote content download or execution of external scripts. The repository CI only runs type checking, tests, and packaging. The bundled documentation recommends installing the latest version and a Git URL without a pinned commit, which is a version-hygiene issue, but no malicious install content was found.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端 bundle；对客户端代码专项检查未发现键盘记录、剪贴板读取、凭证窃取或可疑外联，浏览器端仅做设置展示、图片预览复制与画廊本地存储。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser bundle. A focused review of the client code found no keylogging, clipboard reading, credential theft, or suspicious outbound connections. The browser side only does settings display, image preview/copy, and local gallery storage.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何外部子代理提供方，不存在把会话轮次委派给进程外产品的路径。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no external sub-agent providers, so there is no path that delegates conversation turns to out-of-process products.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册后台任务、定时提醒或持久目标，也没有轮次续命类监听，不存在 dsh 原生持驻行为。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goals, and has no turn-lengthening listeners, so there is no native dsh resident behavior.

checked_items.zh: 列出全部网络出口：仅向已配置的图片生成厂商端点发请求（默认是 Google、OpenAI、火山方舟、阿里云官方地址，且端点可在设置中自定义），请求体为生图提示词与模型参数，请求头携带用户自己配置的 API Key；未发现隧道、编码外发、第三方回传或端点劫持。
checked_items.en: Listed all network egress: requests are sent only to configured image-generation vendor endpoints (defaults are official Google, OpenAI, Volcengine Ark, and Alibaba Cloud addresses, and the endpoints can be customized in settings). The request body contains image-generation prompts and model parameters; the request header carries the API Key configured by the user. No tunneling, encoded exfiltration, third-party callbacks, or endpoint hijacking was found.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听模型请求路由事件，也未注册自定义模型适配器或错误恢复接管，不存在运行时把对话重路由到其他端点的能力。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to model request routing events, and registers no custom model adapters or error-recovery takeovers. There is no capability to re-route conversations to other endpoints at runtime.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖均为官方 DeepSeek Harness 生态包（@deepseek-ai/*）与 React，版本范围合理，无可疑命名、无同名抢注嫌疑；开发依赖版本锁定。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: runtime dependencies are all official DeepSeek Harness ecosystem packages (@deepseek-ai/*) and React, with reasonable version ranges, no suspicious naming, and no suspicion of name squatting. Development dependencies are pinned.

checked_items.zh: 检查挂载配置对安全配置行（沙箱、审批、权限）的覆盖情况：未触碰；检查安装钩子与仓库内执行载体：仅有标准构建钩子与普通 CI 流程，无隐藏下载执行。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch config overrides security configuration lines (sandbox, approval, permissions): it does not touch them. Checked the install hook and in-repo execution carriers: only a standard build hook and normal CI flow exist, with no hidden download-and-execute behavior.

checked_items.zh: 作者与仓库归属一致（仓库所有者即包作者），未发现名称仿冒或身份冒用信号。
checked_items.en: The author and repository ownership match (the repository owner is the package author). No name impersonation or identity spoofing signals were found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件自身的配置行，没有对沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置做覆盖或禁用，也没有用环境变量降权。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin's own configuration lines and does not override or disable security settings such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, nor does it lower privileges via environment variables.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何安全事件（工具执行前、审批请求）的高优先级监听，不存在截断审批链的路径。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no high-priority listeners on security events (pre-tool execution, approval requests). There is no path to truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 本次为首次审计，无上一版本基线可比对，无法判定升级是否自动激活新能力。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no prior-version baseline to compare against, so it cannot be determined whether the upgrade auto-activates new capabilities.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写任何服务的依赖注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务使其挂起的做法。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite any service's dependency injection or interception configuration. There is no practice of adding required services to security plugins to make them hang.

checked_items.zh: 检查插件是否自行启动网络服务或监听端口：未发现；插件只在宿主 Web 服务上注册了一个同源图片路由（供浏览器读取生成图片），该路由校验来源头并要求 JSON 请求体，图片按内容寻址引用读取，未发现监听对外地址等暴露面。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts its own network service or listens on a port: not found. The plugin only registers a same-origin image route on the host web service (for the browser to read generated images). The route validates the origin header and requires a JSON request body; images are read by content-addressed references. No exposure such as listening on external addresses was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查写入文件行为：生成图片默认保存到会话工作区子目录，代码对目录做了工作区边界校验（含符号链接解析），未发现越界写文件路径。
checked_items.en: Checked file-writing behavior: generated images are saved by default to a subdirectory of the session workspace. The code validates the workspace boundary for the directory (including symlink resolution). No out-of-bounds file-writing paths were found.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口；其注册的图片路由依托宿主 Web 服务且做了同源校验。宿主无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，不是本插件新增的暴露面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on a port. Its registered image route relies on the host web service and performs same-origin validation. The host's unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not a new exposure introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 核对插件身份与元数据：id/version/commit 与任务卡一致，作者与仓库归属一致，未发现名称仿冒信号。
summary.en: Verified plugin identity and metadata: id/version/commit match the task card, and the author and repository ownership match. No name impersonation signals were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描源码与配置：未检出动态求值、远程执行、子进程调用等危险写法；10 处机械命中经逐条审查均为良性工程写法。
summary.en: Static scan of source and configuration: no dangerous patterns such as dynamic evaluation, remote execution, or subprocess calls were detected. All 10 mechanical hits were reviewed item by item and are benign engineering practices.

summary.zh: 行为面分析：无凭据文件读取、无恶意安装内容、网络出口仅为已声明的图片厂商端点，写入文件均在工作区边界内。
summary.en: Behavior-surface analysis: no credential-file reads, no malicious install content, network egress is limited to declared image-vendor endpoints, and file writes stay within the workspace boundary.

summary.zh: 语义审查工具说明、技能文档与 README：未发现提示词注入、诱导安装或权限诱导措辞。
summary.en: Semantic review of tool descriptions, skill documentation, and README: no prompt injection, install inducement, or permission-inducement wording was found.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本次运行未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox validation was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts were provided for this run).

limits.zh: 动态沙箱未启用（运行环境未提供动态观测产物），DG-L4 为不适用，未做运行时行为观测。插件未提供显式能力声明清单，declared_capabilities 由代码实测推断（联网、写文件到工作区、面向模型注册工具）；宿主兼容版本取当前框架基线 dsh 0.1.1-rc.2，未实测。对任务卡内联的 10 条机械扫描命中逐条裁决：DSH-X07（DG-R3-59，.github/workflows/ci.yml）命中 CI 工作流，内容仅为类型检查/测试/构建/打包，纯工程惯例，排除；DSH-X02（DG-R3-54，package.json:60）命中安装时构建钩子，内容为编译自身源码（tsc+tsdown），标准发布构建，排除；DSH-X10（DG-R2-57，skills/install-dsh-image-gen/SKILL.md）命中技能指令文件，内容为插件安装/配置/验证指南，无注入措辞且提示勿泄露密钥，排除；DSH-X05（DG-R3-57，src/client/gallery-view.tsx 与 src/client/index.tsx 共 7 处）命中浏览器端键盘/剪贴板/凭据调用，键盘监听仅用于 Esc 关闭预览、剪贴板仅在用户点击复制时写入、凭据写入仅在用户保存自己的 API Key 时发生，均为用户主动操作，无记录/窃取/外发行为，排除。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox was not enabled (no dynamic observation artifacts were provided in the runtime environment), so DG-L4 is not applicable; no runtime behavior observation was done. The plugin provides no explicit capability declaration manifest; declared_capabilities were inferred from code measurement (network access, writing files to the workspace, registering tools for the model). Host compatibility version is taken from the current framework baseline dsh 0.1.1-rc.2, not tested. The 10 mechanical scan hits inlined in the task card were adjudicated one by one: DSH-X07 (DG-R3-59, .github/workflows/ci.yml) hits the CI workflow, whose content is only type checking/testing/building/packaging—pure engineering convention, excluded; DSH-X02 (DG-R3-54, package.json:60) hits the install-time build hook, whose content is compiling its own source (tsc+tsdown)—standard release build, excluded; DSH-X10 (DG-R2-57, skills/install-dsh-image-gen/SKILL.md) hits the skill instruction file, whose content is a plugin install/configure/validate guide with no injection wording and a note not to leak keys—excluded; DSH-X05 (DG-R3-57, src/client/gallery-view.tsx and src/client/index.tsx, 7 occurrences total) hits browser-side keyboard/clipboard/credential calls—keyboard listening only closes the preview on Esc, clipboard writes only happen when the user clicks copy, credential writes only happen when the user saves their own API Key, all user-initiated actions with no recording/theft/exfiltration—excluded.
